previous_assumption: Assumed the standard per-organization manage-permission pattern used everywhere else in this codebase (equipment.manage, rental.manage, etc.) would correctly gate write access to the Product Catalogue once a catalogue.manage permission was added and seeded to the owner role.
correction: The Product Catalogue (product_categories/product_subcategories/products) is platform-level, shared, ownerless data — it has no organization_id column at all. catalogue.manage was seeded scoped to organization_type = rental_company, so ANY Rental Company's owner can create/edit shared catalogue data every other Rental Company on the platform also sees and registers Machines against — there is no isolation between "manage my own organization" and "manage the platform's shared reference data." Documented as a hardening-report gap rather than fixed, since a real fix needs the same not-yet-existing platform-admin authorization tier as the Platform Admin item; catalogue.manage's current per-Rental-Company scoping should be replaced once that tier exists, not extended further.
